hooks.name: Confirm before touching prod (:8080)
hooks.description: Asks the user to confirm any shell command that releases to or restarts prod on port 8080.

action.command: if grep -Eq 'release\.sh|SERVER_PORT=8080|kill .*8080|lsof -t[^"]*:?8080' ; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This command touches PROD (:8080). Confirm you want a prod release."}}'; fi; exit 0
